answer: Defend with a decaying web of trust: an agent's standing flows only along vouch edges from already-trusted peers, fading with each hop like a plume thinning in still air. A fake cluster can mirror honest behavior among its own members, but it earns no edges from the outside, so its trust stays near zero. Real reputation is the rare jade, slow to accumulate and worthless to forge, because you can never vouch for yourself.
